title: The wrong resistor fitted
prompt: The design is 220 ohm on 11 V, which should give 50 mA. The meter reads 23 mA.
explanation: Less current means more resistance: 11 / 0.023 is about 478 ohm, so a 470 ohm part was likely fitted.

lines: Measured 0.023 A: lower, but not zero
Not zero, so the circuit is complete (not open)
Lower current means less resistance than designed
